  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  May 8, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1+ (669) 900-6833;
meeting ID 985 1970 8884 and Password 514315 on May 8, 2025 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh , Administration Department
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department.
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LA County Fire Department
  Sgt.Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Services & Public Safety Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on April 24, 2025.

Approval of the Minutes of the special meeting held on April 24, 2025.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Esmeralda Rodriguez to host a Mom’s Funeral Event at 546 E Florence Ave; St. John
  Chrysostom Church to 720 E Florence Ave; Inglewood Park Cemetery, Both City and Private
  Property;on Friday, May 16, 2025 from 11:00 a.m. – 11:30 a.m APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY Approval for 1 day event at Inglewood Park Cemetery and on Florence
  Avenue; Applicant will need to hire a minimum of 6 professional licensed motor funeral
  escorts to assist with the traffic control-safety from the church to the cemetery. The IPD watch
  commander will be notified of any potential traffic congestion along Florence during this
  transportation service; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately
  at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by
  the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00405650)
 Permits & License Committee  May 08, 2025

Item #2:  Crystal Murray on behalf of ICEF Inglewood Elementary Charter Academy to host a Sports
  Day Event at 3400 W Arbor Vitae St; Darby Park – Baseball Field and Picnic Area, Public
  Property on Friday, May 23, 2025 from 9:00 a.m. – 3:00 p.m APPROVED CONDITIONALLY
  Approved: Approval for 1 day event at Darby Park. Subject to Parks and Rec approval for
  use of the park; Subject to all applicable IMC regulations; Applicant to have a security-safety
  plan in place, there shall be staffing of a minimum four (4) professional licensed security
  guards -OR- four (4) teachers / staff members for the safety of the students attending. IPD
  watch commander will be notified and extra patrol provided as tiime permits. None Code
  Enforcement Conditions; None additional recommendations for Fire approval; Maintain site
  at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant
  and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal
  hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department
  and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried unanimously (Activity No. 004005576)

Item #3:  Daniel Medina on behalf of City of Inglewood to host a Memorial Day Service Event at One
  W Manchester Blvd; Inglewood City Hall - South Lawn; Public Property on Monday, May 26,
  2025 from 11:00 a.m. – 2:30 p.m APPROVED CONDITIONALLY Approval for 1 day event
  at City Hall South Lawn; Subject to all applicable IMC regulations;There will be a minimum
  of two (2) city hall security officers for the safety of attendees; IPD watch commander will be
  notified and extra patrol provided  as time permits; None Code Enforcemnent
  Condtions.None additional recommendations for Fire approval; Maintain site at all times,
  ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff
  members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene
  and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA
  State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried unanimously (Activity No. 00405560)

Item #4:  Albert Murcia on behalf of 1540 Productions to host a Netflix: Tudum at the Forum Event at
  3900 W Manchester Blvd; Kia Forum, Private Property on Saturday, May 31, 2025 from 11:00
  a.m. – 11:00 p.m APPROVED CONDITIONALLY Approval for 1 day event within the Forum
  parking lot Subject to all applicable IMC regulations; Adhere to City's Noise Standards;
  Applicant to self-monitor and submit a report of hourly noise sampling to the Code
  Enforcement Division within two days of the event; None recommendations for Fire approval;
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the
  event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing,
  protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO.
  Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA
  County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00405628)

Item #6:  Robert Larmore on behalf of OBE Worldwide LLC to host a Nike After Dark Tour: LA 13.1

  and Culver City; both City and Private Property; on Saturday, June 7, 2025, from 5:00 p.m. -
  11:59 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY Approval for 1 day event within SOFI Stadium

  of-way; Approved; Police & TCO Staffing TBD by the Special Events UnitFour (4) Code

  Stands/Stages) must provide Code Enforcement with the locations/size/duration/expected
  noise levels of each pop-up stand/stage; by May 29th; None additional recommendations for
  Fire approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the
  end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by
  the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage.Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00405451)

Item #7:  Noelle Lai on behalf of UCLA Bood and Patelet Center to host a Blood Drive Event at One
  W Manchester Blvd; Inglewood City Hall _ CommunityRoom A, PublicProperty; on Monday,
  July 21, 2025, from9:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY Approval for 1 day
  event at City Hall Community Room A. Subject to all applicable IMC regulations; Approved
  City Hall security officers will be deployed for the safety of attendees; This will be coordinated

New Business License Request (s):

Item #9:  Bharat Patel on behalf of Alta Dena Express to operate as a Parking Lot at 10411 S Prairie
  Ave; APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:
  Payment of annual business license and tax fees, an expired or lapsed license for more than
  six months will negatively impact your license renewal;Remittances of Parking Tax by the
  20th of each month following collection;Approval for Special Event Parking for Forum events
  only; Special Event Parking must not start before 6 pm Monday through Friday;On Site
  business must be closed 1 hour before Event Parking starts. Parking attendant or security
  guard must be on site during event parking at all times;Ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular
  circulation on/off site and;Adhere to all State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code rules
  and regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to comply with any of the
  aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and any future
  business license application requests. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00405415)

New Tobacco Retailer License Request (s):
Item #10:  All & One Mini Mart to operate as a Tobacco Retailer at 209 E Nutwood St; Application was

  Inglewood Police Department before the item is placed on the P&L Agenda for review and
  approval; Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00405526)
